title: HMRC email updates, videos and webinars if you’re self-employed
text:
Subscribe to receive email updates

 Subscribe to the HMRC help and support email service to get information on a wide range of topics for individuals, businesses, employers and agents.

 You can also:

 • make changes to your topic subscriptions

 • unsubscribe from the service whenever you want

 Registering and joining webinars

 You can register for webinars in advance but we recommend you join each webinar 5 minutes before the start.

 Tax basics — a starter guide for small businesses

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about tax basics — a starter guide for small businesses .

 If you’re thinking of starting your own business, you can find out about why it is important to get your tax right and all the basics you’ll need to know.

 You will learn about:

 • business banking, accountants and record keeping

 • Income Tax, VAT , Corporation Tax, National Insurance contributions

 • employing people and Pay As You Earn ( PAYE )

 • registering your business with HMRC

 • expenses you can claim and tax reliefs

 • how tax works if your business is a side hustle

 • what happens after you start paying tax

 • budgeting for your first tax bill and correcting errors

 Record keeping

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about record keeping for the self-employed .

 This webinar is aimed at sole traders and partnerships. It is not suitable for those with limited liability partnerships or limited companies.

 This webinar gives an overview on and the importance of keeping good business records.

 You will learn about:

 • unfamiliar terms

 • using records to work out taxable profits

 • information to record

 • records where there is business and private use

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about record keeping for the self-employed .

 Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

 Get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax .

 This webinar will help you understand more about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and the steps you can take to get yourself ready.

 You will learn about:

 • the new rules and when they will affect you

 • what you or your agent will need to do

 • choosing the right software

 • signing up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

 • how to authorise an agent

 • following the rules

 • benefits and opportunities

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax .

 Get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you are a landlord and joint property owner

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you are a landlord and joint property owner .

 You will learn about:

 • the new rules and when they will affect you

 • what you or your agent will need to do

 • choosing the right software

 • how to authorise an agent and sign up

 • following the rules

 • benefits and opportunities

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you are a landlord and joint property owner .

 Get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re a sole trader or landlord without an accountant or bookkeeper

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re a sole trader or landlord without an accountant or bookkeeper .

 This webinar will cover how to sign up and be ready for Making Tax Digital when you have to start using it.

 You will learn about:

 • the new rules and when they affect you

 • what you need to do

 • choosing the right software

 • how to authorise an agent and sign up

 • following the rules

 • benefits and opportunities

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re a sole trader or landlord without an accountant or bookkeeper .

 Self Assessment

 New to Self Assessment

 Watch a collection of videos about Self Assessment on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • key dates

 • the tax return

 • understanding your calculation

 • budgeting for and paying your tax bill

 • record keeping

 • the HMRC app

 • personal and business tax accounts

 Starting Self Assessment

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about starting Self Assessment on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • how to register for Self Assessment

 • which structure to use when registering

 • why you would be sent a tax return

 • your first Self Assessment tax return

 • cryptoassets and paying tax

 Online Self Assessment tax return

 Watch a collection of videos about your online Self Assessment tax return on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • starting your tax return
 the different sections of the return including:

 • the self-employment section

 • the UK property section

 • other income and tax reliefs

 • finishing your return

 • your calculation and payments

 Filling in tax returns

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about filling in tax returns on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • tailoring your Self Assessment tax returns

 • state benefits and your online tax return

 • 
 PAYE underpayments

 • estimated underpayments

 • declaring foreign income to HMRC

 • claiming expenditure against Capital Gains Tax

 • cryptoassets and paying tax

 Self-employed tax returns

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about self-employed tax returns on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • basic record keeping

 • your self-employed tax return

 • cash basis and simplified expenses

 • what expenses you can include in your Self Assessment tax return

 • claiming motoring expenses

 • calculating your business expenses for rent, rates power and insurance costs

 • other allowable business expenses

 • Class 2 National Insurance contributions

 Self Assessment tax bills

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about Self Assessment tax bills on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • viewing your Self Assessment tax return calculation

 • budgeting for your Self Assessment tax bill

 • paying your Self Assessment tax bill

 • using the HMRC app to make a Self Assessment payment

 • help if you cannot pay your tax bill

 • Self Assessment penalties

 • appealing a late filing penalty

 Student loan and postgraduate loan tax returns

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about student loan and postgraduate loan tax returns on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • why your tax return asks about income contingent student loans

 • why your tax return asks about postgraduate loans

 • how to show student loan and postgraduate loan repayments on your tax return

 UK property income — tax returns

 Watch a collection of videos to find out about UK property income — tax returns on YouTube .

 You will find out about:

 • filling in tax returns if you have income from a property

 • Rent-a-Room relief

 • joint lettings

 • the property income allowance

 • rent, rates, insurance and ground rent

 • property repairs and maintenance

 • loan interest and other financial costs

 • other allowance property expenses

 Starting your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about starting your online tax return .

 This webinar will cover how to get started with completing your online Self Assessment tax return.

 You will learn about:

 • who must send a tax return

 • starting your tax return

 • the ‘Tell us about you’ page

 • tailoring your tax return

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about starting your online tax return .

 The employment section of your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about the employment section of your online tax return .

 This webinar will help you understand more about filling in the employment section of your online Self Assessment tax return.

 You will learn about:

 • what employment records you will need

 • the employment page of your tax return

 • showing taxable employment benefits and expenses

 • claiming tax relief on work related expenses

 • student loan and postgraduate loan deductions

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about the employment section of your online tax return .

 The self-employment section of your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about the self-employment section of your online tax return .

 This webinar will cover how to fill in the self-employment section of your online Self Assessment tax return.

 You will learn about entering:

 • details of your business and turnover

 • expenses

 • capital allowances and balancing charges

 • other tax adjustments

 • losses

 • tax deducted and Class 4 National Insurance contributions

 • Class 2 National Insurance contributions

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about the self-employment section of your online tax return .

 The UK property section of your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about the UK property section of your online tax return .

 This webinar will cover filling in the UK property section of your online Self Assessment tax return.

 You will learn about:

 • Rent-a-Room relief and joint lettings

 • the qualifying conditions for furnished holiday lettings

 • when to record income and expenses

 • the property income allowance

 • the property expenses page

 • adjustments for other property income

 • profits and losses for other property income

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about the UK property section of your online tax return .

 Other income and tax reliefs on your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about other income and tax reliefs on your online tax return .

 This webinar will help you understand other income and tax reliefs on your online tax return.

 You will learn about what qualifies as other income, such as:

 • bank interest

 • dividend income

 • state pensions

 • other state benefits

 • work pensions

 • High Income Child Benefit Charge

 And what you may get reliefs on, including:

 • payments into pensions

 • payments to charity

 • blind persons relief

 • marriage allowance

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about other income and tax reliefs on your online tax return .

 Finishing your online tax return

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about finishing your online tax return .

 This webinar will help you understand how to finish your online Self Assessment tax return.

 You will learn about:

 • underpaid tax and other debts

 • overpaid tax

 • what to do if you’ve not paid enough tax

 • checking your return

 • saving and submitting your return

 • amending your return after you’ve sent it

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about finishing your online tax return .

 Your Self Assessment calculation and payments

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about your Self Assessment calculation and payments .

 The webinar will cover your Self Assessment tax return calculation and payments.

 You will learn about:

 • what’s included in your calculation

 • payments on account

 • the full Self Assessment calculation

 • what to pay and when

 • budget payment plans

 • payments already made

 • how to pay

 • what to do if you cannot pay on time

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about your Self Assessment calculation and payments .

 Online tax return help for landlords

 Check help and support for landlords to watch catch up webinars on how to fill in your online tax return for income from property.

 Business expenses

 Watch our short series of videos about expenses.

 Self-employment records you need to keep

 Watch a video about self-employment records that you will need to keep.
